item.title: Ahead of possible US strikes, Zelensky backs action against Iran's regime, 'not against the people'
item.description: Zelensky added that diplomatic talks between the United States and Iran remain the preferred way forward, according to a Sky News interview.

item.title: Is Donbas key to ending Ukraine-Russia war?
item.description: As peace talks continue and the U.S. pushes for compromise, one proposal keeps returning: Ukraine should withdraw from the remainder of Ukrainian-controlled Donetsk Oblast to end the war. The Kyiv Independent’s Francis Farrell explains why the Battle of Donbas remains at the center of the peace process.

item.title: Zelensky invites Fico to Ukraine as Slovakia, Hungary seek to inspect Druzhba pipeline
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky invited Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico to visit Ukraine in a phone call on Feb. 27, amid a row between Kyiv, Budapest, and Bratislava over a key oil pipeline.

item.title: US lifts sanctions on Malian officials linked to Russian Wagner Group
item.description: The United States has lifted sanctions on three senior Malian officials who were previously designated for their ties to Russia's Wagner Group, the Treasury Department announced Feb. 27.

item.title: Ukraine's Flamingo manufacturer unveils new FP-7 ballistic missile in launch test video
item.description: The FP-7 tactical ballistic missile has a range of up to 200 kilometers (124 miles) and carries a combat load of 150 kilograms (about 330 pounds), according to the Ukrainian defense firm Fire Point.

item.title: Drone attack sparks fire at oil refinery in southern Russia, officials say
item.description: Flames engulfed one of the tanks at the Albashneft oil refinery in Novominskaya and burned an adjacent area of about 150 square meters, the Krasnodar Krai Operational Headquarters said.
